source.accroche: my most used apps as someone with ADHD

titre.en: my most used apps as a busy student

legendes.en: the ones that actually stay on my home screen #apprecommendations #productivity #studytok #cuteapps

notes: Pilote du podz 17 (15/11), sur le modèle du post donné par Adrien (« my most used apps / as someone with ADHD », 21 k) : même couverture en collage, même fond de bibliothèque, cinq applis, la fin « save & follow ». Applis réelles (App Store, 15/11) : Structured, Finch, Sophia (3e, cta A : « written by professors », « 10 minutes a day » ; ses vraies captures : accueil, quiz, cours fini), DailyBean, Routinery. Photos Seedream.

en.note: A visual planner that puts your tasks and calendar on one timeline, so you can actually see how your day fits together
A little self-care pet that grows when you take care of yourself: drink water, stretch, journal, go outside
Short lessons on history, philosophy and science, written by professors, with a quiz after each one. 10 minutes a day
A no-writing journal: tap your mood and what you did, and it turns your days into a cute little calendar
Turns your morning and night routines into a step-by-step timer, so you stop losing 20 minutes between tasks
